title: The number of labeled partial orders and topologies on 19 points
summary: We report the exact value of the number of labeled partially ordered sets (equivalently, labeled $T_0$ topologies) on 19 points, P(19) = 646099441937791106493755218560442089979, a 39-digit integer extending OEIS A001035, whose largest previously computed term was P(18) (Brinkmann and McKay). By the Stirling transform we also obtain the number of labeled topologies on 19 points, A000798(19) = 689054943207246404281592791142107048261.
